$comment: Self-hosted toolkit settings. Assumes the plugin marketplace is registered at user level via ~/.claude/settings.json — run ./install.sh (see README '## Quick start'). Plugins bring their own hooks; nothing needs registering here. Auto memory is NOT redirected here: autoMemoryDirectory must be an absolute path, so it belongs in per-machine .claude/settings.local.json (see the memory plugin README, 'Auto memory').
